run_distillation_training: run teacher-student distillation training for Whisper speech recognition models
load_multiple_datasets: load and interleave multiple HuggingFace datasets for distillation training with configurable sampling
compute_wer_metrics: compute word error rate metrics with normalization for speech recognition evaluation
prepare_train_dataset: preprocess audio and text for training with optional timestamp filtering and prompt conditioning
rotate_checkpoints: rotate and delete old checkpoints to manage disk space during training
